purpose: detect visible floor-like authored mesh geometry that can support the player footprint but lacks corresponding runtime world collision

geometry_policy.legacy_winding_policy: absolute normal Y; do not trust source winding

explicit_non_solid_exemptions.rationale: known view/helper/water/decorative semantics; exemptions are explicit and audited rather than inherited from room_manager collision exclusions

runtime_pass_requires: every non-exempt visible floor-like mesh above threshold has Collision_<object>
each collision body is layer 1 / mask 4
each collision shape is ConcavePolygonShape3D with backface_collision=true
R1/Object02 is independently discovered by the generic geometry rule and has Collision_Object02
evidence_boundary: The source contract only proves the generic auditor and policy are present. Asset-backed Godot execution is required; no Candidate 4 preflight may pass without v120 runtime PASS.
